disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder; clinical cohort from ABIDE-I (discovery, N=333) and ABIDE-II (replication, N=302). Normative model was built on HCP-D TD individuals and applied to ASD individuals to compute centile score deviations.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition characterized by a wide range of behavioral phenotypes"; "By applying normative modeling with the generalized additive model for location, scale, and shape (GAMLSS), we captured the nonlinear trajectories of the developing functional gradient, as well as the individual-level deviations in ASD from typical development based on centile scores measured as deviations from the normative curves."

dataset-of-origin.detail: ABIDE-I used as discovery dataset (N=702; ASD=333, TD=369) and ABIDE-II used as replication dataset (N=657; ASD=302, TD=355). Both are multi-site datasets. HCP-D (N=652, TD only) was used solely for normative model construction and is not part of the clinical cohort.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Two large-scale independent datasets from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE), termed the ABIDE I and II [...] were analyzed."; "We utilized ABIDE-I data for the primary normative modeling analyses, and the reproducibility was assessed using ABIDE-II data"
dataset-of-origin.location: Lee2025.pdf.md: Methods / Study participants, L53; Methods / Normative modeling, L84-L85

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD computed from ABIDE-I ASD (N=333, mean=13.91, SD=3.58) and ABIDE-II ASD (N=302, mean=11.93, SD=4.01).
